Prediabetes.medication: Lifestyle-first therapy; consider Metformin for high-risk patients
Prediabetes.dosage: Metformin 500 mg once daily with food when prescribed

Type 1 Diabetes.dosage: Initial total daily dose often 0.4-0.6 units/kg/day, individualized by physician

Type 2 Diabetes.dosage: 500 mg once or twice daily with meals; titrate gradually as tolerated
warnings: GI upset is common during initiation

Severe.dosage: Individualized correction and basal dosing based on glucose, weight, and clinical context
warnings: Seek urgent care for vomiting, confusion, ketones, or glucose persistently above 300 mg/dL

Low Diabetes Risk.medication: No diabetes medication indicated from this screen
warnings: This is decision support, not a diagnosis
